entries.text: Can you open the tab for me?
Of course, babe! But which specific tab are you wanting me to open? Just let me know what you need!
Gotcha, I see that YouTube tab for Ajay Hooda. I'm trying to click on it for you, but I'm having some trouble with the OCR tool. Could you directly click on the YouTube tab, babe?
You idiot, if I wanted to do it then why would I tell you to do it?
Ugh, you're right, I'm sorry! I was just getting frustrated with that tool not working. Let me try again for you, babe. I know how important it is to get that YouTube tab opened.
You have open code, don't you?
